governing_rule: No post-gate implementation may assign semantic meaning to Gamma that is not present in this frozen contract.

causal_interface.output: DeltaPi as canonical licensed probe identities

licensed_rewrites: raw path_id renaming with references preserved
raw equivalence-label renaming with partition preserved

revision_equivalence.definition: two semantic references are revision-equivalent iff Gamma places them in the same equivalence block
revision_equivalence.q_effect: Gamma_B is a coarser revision equivalence relation than Gamma_A

allowed_path_operations.TRACE: return the canonical revision block containing a semantic reference
allowed_path_operations.FOLLOW: follow a canonical revision block to its shared W source-fact references
allowed_path_operations.CHALLENGE: form a non-authoritative challenge probe over one canonical revision block
allowed_path_operations.REOPEN: form a non-authoritative reopen probe over one canonical revision block
allowed_path_operations.COMPARE: form a discriminating probe between two distinct canonical revision blocks of the same relation kind
allowed_path_operations.SPLIT: PROHIBITED_AT_FIRST_ENDPOINT; a split requires later independently validating fresh evidence

forbidden_path_operations: count equivalence classes to assign probe value
score matrix density or row sums
branch on raw class label or arm label
hash Gamma and map hash to probe semantics
use representation order as semantic input
invent a path operation not listed in allowed_path_operations

first_endpoint.unit: unordered pair of canonical semantic references
first_endpoint.reachable_rule: a DISTINGUISHED future pair is reachable iff the two references remain in distinct Gamma revision blocks and a canonical COMPARE probe is therefore legal
first_endpoint.equivalent_rule: an EQUIVALENT future pair is not a target distinction and contributes no treatment advantage
first_endpoint.missingness_rule: NOT_IDENTIFIED remains NOT_IDENTIFIED and is never imputed as EQUIVALENT or DISTINGUISHED
first_endpoint.aggregation: report pairwise results and identified coverage; no topology-weighted utility score

future_distinction_table.required_domain: all 12 nontrivial q-kernel merged semantic-reference pairs
future_distinction_table.grounding_requirement: Before H can pass, freeze an external treatment-blind rule that maps the realized future obligation to a complete status for every q-kernel pair or NOT_IDENTIFIED, without using Gamma_A/Gamma_B, Phi_path, arm outcomes, or DeltaPi.

evaluator.name: V_Pi_pair_reachability
evaluator.duplicate_rule: canonical semantic probe identity deduplicates representation duplicates
evaluator.invalid_probe_rule: invalid or undeclared operations are rejected, not scored
evaluator.abstention_rule: NOT_IDENTIFIED is preserved as missing identification, not failure or zero
evaluator.future_kernel_witness: exists a q-kernel pair with status DISTINGUISHED
evaluator.generativity_contrast: conditional on a DISTINGUISHED q-kernel pair, compare whether the licensed COMPARE probe is reachable under Gamma_A versus Gamma_B
